designationHistory.indexText: Cache River National Wildlife Refuge Cache River National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1986 to protect significant wetland habitats and provide feeding and resting areas for migrating waterfowl.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
